description: Register an HTTPS webhook as an alert delivery channel for the current user. We POST signed JSON to the URL when alerts fire, and once right now: a signed `test` event whose result comes back as `test` ({ok, status} or {ok, error}); a failing test does not refuse the channel. Every POST is signed with HMAC-SHA256: pass your own `secret` (>=16 chars) or we generate one and return it as `secret` in this answer (show it to the user now; it is shown at registration and again any time on Account -> Alerts -> channels, Show secret; alerts_rotate_webhook_secret issues a new one). The test is signed with that secret, so a receiver that checks signatures answers 401/403 until it has it: if your receiver needs the secret first, install it and call alerts_test_webhook. Recipients verify by computing HMAC-SHA256(secret, '{X-Vike-Timestamp}.{body}') over the RAW body and comparing it, in constant time, to EVERY `sig=` value of X-Vike-Signature: accept the delivery if ANY of them matches (during a secret rotation the header carries two). Replays should be rejected if timestamp is more than ~5 min old. Payload, headers and a verification example: https://vike.io/data/api#mcp-alerts

secret.description: Optional HMAC secret (>=16 chars). If omitted, we generate one and return it as `secret` in the answer.

url.description: Webhook URL, https:// only. Must be reachable from our server.
